Tempo Map

  • CURIE: gmeow:TempoMap
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TempoMap
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

A TimeMapping from a musical-time frame to a clock-time frame, expressed piecewise as constant, linear ramp, curve, or measured segments. Tempo is a frame mapping, not a single number, unless it happens to be one (Principle 11).

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:TimeMapping

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:TempoMap as a specialized kind of gmeow:TimeMapping. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
